sub_sector.value: Distilled spirits production and branded whiskey; specialty grain food ingredients

product_category.detail: Distilled spirits (whiskey, bourbon, rye, gin) and grain-based food ingredients such as flours and proteins.

market_position.detail: Premium whiskeys, bourbons and other distilled spirits plus specialty food ingredient solutions.

distribution_model.detail: Sells distilled spirits and ingredients business-to-business to brand owners, distillers and food manufacturers; also its own branded spirits.

purchase_frequency.detail: Spirits are discretionary purchases; ingredients are supplied to manufacturers.

notes: Largely a business-to-business supplier; consumer-facing facets reflect end products and brands.
